# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.1

## 2026-08-16

## Changed

- Default the WebRTC ICE candidate filter to `prefer_ipv4_ula` instead of
  `all`, avoiding rotating global/SLAAC IPv6 and link-local candidates while
  keeping IPv4, stable local ULA IPv6, and TURN relays.

## Fixed

- Refresh the native Alarmo display page when it becomes visible again and make
  its display-off return behaviour follow the same configured option as the
  Home Assistant dashboard page.
- Fix native-agent update metadata after v1.9.0 shipped a changed agent binary
  under the previous visible agent version. The packaged native agent now
  reports `1.9.0`, and future releases fail validation if native-agent or
  bundled device files change without a matching `native_agent/VERSION` bump.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant so it reports
  `1.9.0`; active display patches should be refreshed by the agent update path.
